import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
libgsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototype
libgsl.gsl_sf_lngamma_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
libgsl.gsl_sf_lngamma_e.restype = ctypes.c_int


def compute_lngamma(x):
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = libgsl.gsl_sf_lngamma_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError('Error in computing lngamma')
    return result.val
